Instructions: ['Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper.', 'Saute in 4 tablespoons butter until slightly brown.', 'Cover and cook 25-30 minutes or until done, turning occasionally.', 'While chicken is cooking, cook noodles and drain well.', 'Mix with 2 tablespoons butter and salt and pepper to taste.', 'Whip the heavy cream.', 'Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan and blend in flour.', 'Add milk and pineapple juice and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.', 'Add a little of the sauce mixture to the egg yolks; return all to saucepan and stir well.', 'Fold in whipped cream and season with salt and pepper to taste.', 'When chicken is done, place noodles in a 13x9 broiler-safe baking pan.', 'Top with chicken and cover to keep warm.', 'Cook mushrooms and onion in the butter remaining in the skillet used to cook the chicken.', 'Add parsley and bread crumbs.', 'Mix well and season with salt and pepper.', 'Place a pineapple slice on each chicken breast and top with a mound of the mushroom mixture.', 'Pour the pineapple sauce over all and sprinkle with grated Parmesan.', 'Brown under the broiler.']

Name: Chunky Herring Spread
Ingredients: ['1 (12 ounce) jar herring fillets, in wine sauce (or tidbits)', '1 (8 ounce) container sour cream', '12 cup cucumber, chopped', '1 leek, chopped (save some thinly sliced rings for garnish)', '14 cup red bell pepper, finely chopped', '12 teaspoon celery seed', '14 teaspoon ground red pepper']
Instructions: ['Drain the jar of herring filets (tidbits), and cut into 1/4 to 1/2-inch slices.', 'After you have chopped the cucumber, leek and bell pepper,.', 'mix everything together.', 'Garnish with additional rings of leeks and cucumber slices.', 'Serve with small slices of rye and/or pumpernickel bread.']

Name: Spaghetti Pie
Ingredients: ['2 cups cooked spaghetti', '1 ounce grated parmesan cheese', '1 egg, beaten', '1 tablespoon margarine, softened', '1 teaspoon margarine, softened', '23 cup ricotta cheese', '2 teaspoons margarine', '12 cup diced onion', '12 cup diced green pepper', '1 garlic clove, minced', '6 ounces cooked ground beef, crumbled', '1 cup canned chopped tomato, reserve liquid', '2 teaspoons tomato paste', '2 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese']
Instructions: ['Prepare crust: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients.', 'Spray a 9 inch glass pie plate with nonstick cooking spray; spread spaghetti mixture over bottom and up sides of pie plate to form a crust.', 'Prepare filling: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.', 'Carefully spread ricotta cheese over bottom of crust and set aside.', 'Heat margarine in a skillet until bubbly and hot; add onion, bell pepper and garlic and saute until onion is translucent.', 'Add beef, tomatoes, reserved liquid, and tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is slightly thickened and throughly heated; spoon beef mixture over ricotta cheese and bake until pie is thoroughly heated, about 20 to 25 minutes.', 'Sprinkle pie with mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese is melted and just begins to brown, about 5 minutes; remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.']

Name: Hula Chicken
Ingredients: ['2 cups teriyaki cooked chicken (cubed or strips)', '1 small green pepper, cut in strips', '1 small maui onion, diced', '1 -2 garlic clove, minced', '2 (10 3/4 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup', '1 (13 ounce) can pineapple chunks in juice', '2 tablespoons peanut oil', '2 tablespoons soy sauce', '3 cups cooked rice or 3 cups noodles', '14 cup macadamia nuts, crushed']
Instructions: ['Cook green pepper and garlic in oil until tender.', 'Blend in soup and pineapple juice; add chicken, pineapple tidbits and soy sauce.', 'Heat, stirring occasionally.', 'Add macadamia nuts prior to serving.', 'Serve over rice or noodles.']

Name: Old Dominion Chocolate Pie
Ingredients: ['1 cup flour, all-purpose', '1/2 teaspoon salt', '6 tablespoons butter or margarine', '1 each egg yolks', '3/4 cup sugar', '1/2 cup flour, all-purpose', '1/4 teaspoon salt', '3 cups milk', '2 ounces chocolate unsweetened', '3 each egg yolks lightly beaten', '2 tablespoons butter', '1 teaspoon vanilla extract']
Instructions: ['Mix flour and salt in a mixing bowl.', 'Cut the cold butter in with a pastry blender until the mixture resembles coarse meal.', 'Whisk the egg yolk and 2 Tb.', 'cold water together and add to the flour mixture.', 'Blend until the pastry is smooth and holds together in a ball.', 'This pastry will not get tough if you handle it a lot and you can even mix it in a food processor.', 'Bake the pastry dough for 12 minutes, until lightly browned.', 'Set aside.', 'Combine the milk and chocolate in a saucepan and heat, stirring until the chocolate and milk are smoothly blended.', 'Combine the sugar, flour and salt in a saucepan.', 'Stir in the milk/chocolate and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thick.', 'Add the egg yolks and continue cooking, stirring for 3 minutes.', 'Remove from heat and blend in the butter and vanilla.', 'Let the custard cool for about 15 minutes, then pour it into the pie shell and refrigerate until ready to serve.']

Name: Grilled Bacon Dogs
Ingredients: ['6 piece bacon', '6 hot dogs']
Instructions: ['Heat grill on high.', 'Wrap your hot dog with a piece of bacon.', 'My grill is a 5 burner.', 'You have to turn off one side of your grill to cook the bacon dogs .', 'You do this because bacon grease causes flare ups .', 'So i turned off the left 2 burners of my grill and kept the other 3 burning on high.', 'Turn the bacon dogs every couple of minutes to get grill marks and to even the crispy Ness.', 'Mine took about 15 minutes or so.', 'The longer you cook them, the better they get.']

Name: Kicked Up Goulash
Ingredients: ['1/2 pounds Ground Turkey', '1/2 pounds Ground Turkey Sausage', '1 cube Beef Bouillon', '1/2 cups Finely Chopped Onion', '1/2 cups Finely Chopped Red Bell Pepper', '14- 1/2 ounces, fluid Canned Diced Tomatoes', '15 ounces, fluid Canned Tomato Sauce, Italian Flavored', '2 teaspoons Soy Sauce', '1/2 teaspoons Dried Basil', '1/4 teaspoons Red Pepper Flakes', '3/4 teaspoons Dried Oregano', '1 Tablespoon Minced Garlic (jarred)', '1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper', '1 cup Macaroni (uncooked)', '2 Tablespoons Butter']
Instructions: ['1.', 'In a large seasoned cast iron skillet (or nonstick skillet) on medium high heat, brown the ground turkey meats together, stirring and breaking up the meat as you go.', 'Add in the bouillon cube as you brown the meats.', '2.', 'Add the onion and bell pepper and saute together until the vegetables soften.', '3.', 'Add the rest of the ingredients, except for the macaroni and butter.', 'Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.', '4.', 'Add the uncooked macaroni, cover, simmer for 20 more minutes.', 'If your mixture is thick when you add the macaroni, add a little water or tomato sauce.', 'There should be enough liquid in the pan to cook the macaroni.', '5.', 'After the goulash is completely cooked, add the butter.', 'I used salted butter.', 'I didnt add any salt to the dish because I felt it was salty enough with the butter and the bouillon.', '6.', 'Let stand approximately 10 to 20 minutes.', 'The longer you let it stand before eating, the more the macaroni softens up.', 'Recipe inspired by Bobby Deens Goulash.']

Ingredients: ['2 whole Organic Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts', 'Olive Oil, For Drizzling', 'Salt And Pepper, to taste', '1 cup Cooked Quinoa', '2 cups Coconut Milk', '1 Tablespoon Earth Balance Butter', '1 cup Sliced Mushrooms', '2 teaspoons GF Soy Sauce', '1 piece Lime', '1/4 cups Smooth Peanut Butter', '5 ounces, fluid Silken Tofu', '1 clove Garlic', '1 teaspoon Hot Sauce', '1 teaspoon Rice Wine Vinegar', '8 whole Lettuce Leaves', '1/4 cups Peeled Carrots (Thinly Sliced- We Used A Mandolin)', '1/4 cups Cucumber (Thinly Sliced- We Used A Mandolin)']
Instructions: ['For the chicken: Preheat your grill to 400 F. While the grill is heating make a simple marinade for your chicken by combining a splash of olive oil, salt and pepper in a shallow bowl.', 'Place your chicken in your marinade and let it sit in the fridge until your grill is hot.', 'When the grill is ready place your chicken on it and grill for 15 minutes, turning halfway through.', 'For the mushroom quinoa filling: Rinse the quinoa in cold water.', 'Add the coconut milk and the quinoa into a sauce pot.', 'Bring it to a boil and then reduce heat to a simmer for 15 minutes to cook.', 'While the quinoa cooks, add the Earth Balance butter to a pan and heat over medium heat.', 'Once the butter has melted add your mushrooms.', 'Cook low and slow for 5-7 minutes.', 'Add the soy sauce for extra flavor.', 'When the quinoa is cooked, add it to your mushrooms.', 'Add a dash of salt and pepper, a splash of half of a lime and stir to combine.', 'For the peanut tofu sauce: Combine your peanut butter, tofu, minced garlic clove, hot sauce and a splash of rice wine vinegar in the food processor.', 'Blend until smooth and creamy.', 'For the assembly: When your chicken is cooked, shred it with two forks or you can cut it into strips.', 'Put your mushroom quinoa in a bowl.', 'Wash and dry your lettuce leaves and place them on a plate.', 'Assemble your wraps, and dip it in the peanut tofu sauce.', 'We like to add the carrots, cucumber and a splash of lime on top!', 'Enjoy!']

Instructions: ['In a gallon size zip lock bag mix flour, salt and pepper.', 'Toss the stew meat in batches in flour mixture and put aside until all of the meat has been coated.', 'In a very large stock pot put about 1/4 cup oil and heat on medium high until hot.', "I do 3 batches of meat, add to the oil the floured stew meat and turn heat to medium, fry until oil is absorbed by the meat, don't worry if the meat looks mushy, that is the way it is supposed to look.", 'Remove the first 2 batches of meat and put aside.', "Leave the 3rd batch in the pan and after cooking add the water and beef granules and let it cook about 15 minutes to give the broth time to thicken up, this is the time I add more flour 1/4 cup at a time to thicken it to the way I like it, just sprinkle flour and stir to mix, don't worry it will break down during cooking.", 'Add the vegetables, bay leaves as well as prime rib bone or short ribs.', 'Adjust your seasoning to the way you like it.', 'Simmer for about 6 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender, DO NOT COVER THE PAN.', 'Add the can of peas just before serving.']

Name: Jerk Shrimp and Rice
